items.title: Is Universal Basic Income the Answer to A.I.-Fueled Job Losses?
items.desc: The New York Times followed recipients of universal basic income programs for more than a year, examining whether the cash payments that Elon Musk and other tech leaders promote can answer job losses attributed to A.I. [NYT, published 2026-10-12]

footnote: Window: 2026-10-11 (last run) → 2026-10-12. All sources were reachable this run. arXiv, INFORMS, NBER and The Economist had no new matching items; SSRN searches turned up no papers with a verified in-window posting date; one Washington Post item (DOGE alumni profiting) was judged off-topic.
